title: Role-Adaptive Policy Optimization for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.40149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy regularization in offline reinforcement learning balances policy improvement against reliance on uncertain value estimates. This balance can differ between selecting actions for execution and supplying actions for critic bootstrapping, yet methods such as TD3+BC couple these roles through a shared policy. We propose Role-Adaptive Policy Optimization (RAPO), which adapts policy-update coefficients according to their roles in value learning and execution. RAPO learns these coefficients by differentiating through candidate policy updates formed using the base algorithm's actor objective. For TD3+BC, RAPO separates bootstrap and execution actors and adapts their coefficients independently: the bootstrap objective penalizes policy-induced changes in target values, while the execution objective evaluates a local policy-improvement surrogate. translated_title: 离线强化学习的角色自适应策略优化
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习中的策略正则化需要在策略改进与依赖不确定价值估计之间进行平衡。这种平衡在选择动作用于执行和提供动作用于评论家自举（bootstrapping）这两个场景下可能有所不同，然而诸如TD3+BC等方法通过共享策略将这两种角色耦合在一起。我们提出角色自适应策略优化（RAPO），它根据策略在价值学习和执行中的不同角色来自适应地调整策略更新系数。RAPO通过使用基础算法的参与者（actor）目标所形成的候选策略更新进行微分来学习这些系数。对于TD3+BC，RAPO将自举参与者与执行参与者分离，并独立调整二者的系数：自举目标对策略引起的目标值变化施加惩罚，而执行目标则评估一个局部的策略改进替代指标。对于IQL这种价值学习已经独立于执行参与者的方法，RAPO保留了其原有结构。
tldr: 本文提出RAPO方法，通过根据策略在评论家自举与动作执行中的不同角色自适应地调整策略更新系数，解决了传统方法（如TD3+BC）中共享策略导致两种角色耦合的问题，从而改进离线强化学习的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Role-Adaptive Policy Optimization (RAPO), which adaptively adjusts policy-update coefficients according to the policy's distinct roles in critic bootstrapping versus action execution, decoupling the roles that methods like TD3+BC couple through a shared policy to improve offline reinforcement learning.
